Theo, politely.

line.en: Good evening. Under the radar too?
line.vi: Chào buổi tối. Anh cũng lẻn à?

twist: They sneak out for a midnight sledding; they stay under the radar until the strict manager is revealed to be sneaking too.
cta_vi: Thử đặt câu với 'under the radar' ở dưới nhé 👇

setting: Sunny Colorado ski slope in 1997, bright powder snow, pine trees, chairlift cables overhead, tiny skiers in colorful jackets in the distance, deep blue sky

phrase.explain_vi: Ngủ rất say hoặc bất tỉnh.
phrase.example_en: He fell asleep. He's out cold.
phrase.example_vi: Anh ấy ngủ rồi. Ngủ say như chết.

hook_vi: Cô ngủ gục trên ghế nâng

shots.action: Chairlift at the end of the day; Sienna's head nods onto Theo's shoulder; she's asleep with her mouth open.
Theo whispers to the camera.

line.vi: Cô ấy ngủ say như chết.

shots.action: The lift reaches the top; Theo scoops up the sleeping Sienna, carrying her on his back, skis on his shoulders.
He skis down carefully with her snoring softly on his back, a sleeping scarf trailing behind.
Sienna wakes up on his back at the bottom, dazed.

line.vi: Em ngủ quên hả?

shots.action: Theo grins, dimple showing; she kisses his neck sleepily.

line.vi: Em trượt. Anh chỉ cõng.

twist: She falls asleep on the chairlift; he carries her all the way... and she wakes up on his back at the top.
cta_vi: Nếu là Theo, bạn trả lời sao? Comment tiếng Anh 👇

setting: Snowy log cabin porch in 1997 with a swing seat, icicles on the eaves, string lights, a snowman in the yard, deep pine forest behind

phrase.explain_vi: Giữ cơ thể ấm áp khi trời lạnh.
phrase.example_en: Drink this to keep warm.
phrase.example_vi: Uống cái này để giữ ấm.

hook_vi: Cách giữ ấm của anh ấy: ôm

shots.action: Cabin sofa; Sienna wrapped in a blanket shivering; Theo walking in with a pile of hot water bottles.
Theo, concerned.

line.vi: Đây. Giữ ấm nhé.

shots.action: Sienna hugs five hot water bottles, two under her arms, one on each foot; she still shivers.
Sienna, peeking from the blanket, sly.

line.vi: Không hiệu quả. Anh có ý gì không?

shots.action: Theo, understanding, with a half smile.

line.vi: Chỉ một. Dịch qua chút.

shots.action: Theo wraps the blanket around both; the hot water bottles fall off one by one; the fire crackles.

twist: Theo hands her fifteen hot water bottles; she says there's a better way, and it doesn't need a bottle.
cta_vi: Tag người bạn hay nói 'keep warm' 👇

setting: Snowy log cabin porch in 1997 with a swing seat, icicles on the eaves, string lights, a snowman in the yard, deep pine forest behind

phrase.explain_vi: Rất lo lắng cho ai đó.
phrase.example_en: I was worried sick about you.
phrase.example_vi: Mình lo phát ốm vì bạn.

hook_vi: Cô trượt mất tích, anh tìm ra

shots.action: Dusk on the slope; Theo with a lantern calls her name, searching the trees.
Theo, anxious, to the empty snow.

line.vi: Sienna? Làm ơn bình an.

shots.action: A snoring sound from a big hollow snowman; the lid hat lifts; Sienna's sleepy face and a thermos.
Sienna, yawning.

line.vi: Em ổn. Trốn tìm hả?

shots.action: Theo, relieved and a bit teary, hugging her.

line.vi: Anh lo phát ốm, Sienna.

shots.action: Sienna offers him a place in the snowman; he squeezes in; the hat closes over them.

twist: Theo searches the whole mountain for lost Sienna: she's been asleep inside the snowman's belly.
cta_vi: Dùng 'worried sick' đặt một câu nhé. Comment bằng tiếng Anh 👇

setting: Outdoor ice rink in a Christmas village in 1997, strings of bulbs overhead, skaters circling, a hot-cocoa stand beside the boards, soft falling snow

phrase.explain_vi: Chắc chắn, rõ ràng là tốt nhất.
phrase.example_en: This is hands down the best cocoa.
phrase.example_vi: Đây chắc chắn là ly cocoa ngon nhất.

hook_vi: Cuộc thi ly cocoa ngon nhất

shots.action: Christmas market; Sienna and Theo are judges, with clipboards, at a long table with three mugs.
Sienna sips, eyes closing.

line.vi: Mm. Cái này hoàn hảo.

shots.action: Theo tastes the next, nods.

line.en: This one is better. Hands down.
line.vi: Cái này ngon hơn. Không bàn cãi.

shots.action: An elderly lady behind the third stall waves her ladle and winks at Theo; he waves back, caught.
Sienna narrows her eyes.

line.vi: Bà là bà của anh!

shots.action: Theo shrugs, handing her a gold paper crown for the winner; she sets it on the old lady's head and kisses her cheek.

twist: They judge three cocoa stalls; hands down, the winner is the one run by Theo's grandmother.
cta_vi: Bạn sẽ nói gì nếu là Sienna? Comment tiếng Anh nhé 👇

setting: Outdoor hot spring pool ringed by snow-covered boulders in 1997, rising steam, pine trees dusted with snow, blue evening light, lanterns on wooden posts

phrase.explain_vi: Đáp lại khi ai đó mong điều không bao giờ xảy ra, nửa đùa.
phrase.example_en: Beat me at chess? You wish!
phrase.example_vi: Thắng mình cờ vua á? Mơ đi!

hook_vi: Cô thách anh bơi qua hồ nóng

shots.action: Hot spring pool at sunset; Sienna and Theo at one edge in swimwear, steam rising.
Theo, calm.

line.vi: Anh sẽ về đích trước.

shots.action: Sienna, laughing.

line.vi: Mơ đi cưng!

shots.action: They swim; Sienna splashes wildly and goes nowhere; Theo glides smoothly and touches the far rock.
Theo waits at the far edge, holding up her robe.

line.vi: Anh thắng. Áo choàng của em.

shots.action: Sienna glares, then splashes him; he pulls her into a hug in the water and kisses her.

twist: She bets he can't beat her across the hot spring; 'you wish'; he wins, then fishes her robe from the water.
cta_vi: Theo hay Sienna thắng? Comment tiếng Anh nhé 👇
